content: कुरवः(बः), कुरव(ब)कः A species of amaranth; [Barlaria Prionitis Linn] It is a handsome shrub. Kālidāsa describes the plant as कान्तामुखद्युति (<ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ṛs. 6. 18</ls>). Modern scientists describe it as a lipped flower referring to the form of its petals. कुरवका रवकारणतां ययुः <ls>R. 9. 29</ls>; <ls>Me. 80</ls>; <ls>Ṛs. 6. 18</ls>. .{@-वम्@} ({@-बम्@}) {@-व(ब)कम्@} The flower of this tree; चूडापाशे नवकुरवकम् <ls>Me. 67</ls>; प्रत्याख्यातविशेषकं कुरवकं श्यामावदातारुणम् <ls>M. 3. 5</ls>.
